Gifted: Size Change.name: Gifted: Size Change
Gifted: Size Change.description:
🧬 Size Change, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start your hands, forearms or feet swell to car-door size in a second, enough to swat a person flat, hold someone in a palm or shelter people under a cupped hand.
📈 With training: double height, a block in a few strides, apartment-building height for a minute, stomps that topple enemies, a falling bus caught with all inside unhurt.
⚠️ Growth adds strength, not toughness, and you pay for what giant steps break.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as extra mass burns your energy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mount Lady (Gigantification), Itsuka Kendo (Big Fist).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Size Change.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Size Change family): Scale: the user grows their own body or parts of it, gaining strength and weight in proportion. A new adult user swells hands, forearms or feet to about car-door size in a second, holding several minutes; whole-body growth needs techniques, and giant height lasts about a minute at first. Limits: strength, not toughness: bullets and blades still wound a bigger target. No shrinking below normal; nothing grows but the user's body. Grown hands fumble fine work; a grown body cannot fit through doors, cracks floors and roads, and can crush people with a careless step. Quirk Strain: light: hands or feet; moderate: grip, doubled height, long stride; heavy: apartment-building height, giant stomp; severe: signature drop, careful giant rescue. Type: Transformation. Law: unlicensed public growth is an offense; every car, pipe and window a giant form breaks goes on the user's record and bill.
